findings.msg: order-* combined with asymmetric grid tracks
findings.fix: order moves the item, not the track width: the fixed-size element lands in the fluid track and stretches. Use symmetric tracks, or swap the track definition per breakpoint.

findings.msg: Three or more distinct content widths in one file
